title: Create valid book returns 201 (REQ-002)
description: Happy path: Admin creates a book with valid title, author, and price. Verifies 201 status and response body structure.
preconditions: Acquire Bearer token for an admin user.
steps: POST /books with headers {Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>, Content-Type: application/json} and body {"title":"Test Book","author":"Author","price":9.99}
Capture created id from response.body.id as <BOOK_ID>

title: Delete book by ID (REQ-002)
description: Admin deletes a previously created book to verify deletion capability and subsequent 404.
steps: DELETE /books/<BOOK_ID> with headers {Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>}
GET /books/<BOOK_ID> expecting 404 to confirm deletion

title: List books with pagination defaults (REQ-002)
description: Functional: Retrieving the book list without specifying page/limit uses default values and returns a page of results.
preconditions: Database contains at least one book.
steps: GET /books

title: View non-existent book returns 404 (REQ-002-AC2)
description: Negative: Querying a book ID that does not exist returns 404 NOT_FOUND.
steps: GET /books/99999999

title: Create book missing title returns 400 (REQ-002-AC3)
description: Negative: Creating a book without the required 'title' field returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.
preconditions: Acquire Bearer token for an admin user via POST /auth/login
steps: POST /books with headers {Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>, Content-Type: application/json} and body {"author":"Author","price":5.00}

title: Non-admin attempts to create book returns 403
description: Security: Authenticated user with non-admin role cannot create books, returns 403 FORBIDDEN.
preconditions: Acquire Bearer token for a non-admin user via POST /auth/login
steps: POST /books with headers {Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>, Content-Type: application/json} and body {"title":"Book","author":"Auth","price":5.00}

title: Create book with invalid price returns 400
description: Boundary: Price must be >= 0.01; submitting 0.00 or negative returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.
preconditions: Acquire Bearer token for an admin user via POST /auth/login
steps: POST /books with headers {Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>, Content-Type: application/json} and body {"title":"Bad Price Book","author":"Author","price":0.00}

title: Invalid limit parameter returns 400
description: Boundary: Passing limit > 50 should return 400 INVALID_LIMIT.
steps: GET /books?limit=100

title: Access profile with invalid token returns 401
description: Security: Accessing protected resource without a valid Bearer token results in unauthorized access. No cleanup needed.
steps: GET /users/me with headers {Authorization: Bearer invalid_token_xyz}

title: Login with invalid credentials returns 401
description: Verifies that incorrect username or password results in a 401 Unauthorized status code.
preconditions: A valid user exists in the system
steps: POST /auth/login with headers {Content-Type: application/json} and body {"username": "<USERNAME>", "password": "wrong_password"}

title: Add valid book to cart (201)
description: Happy path: adding a book with valid ID and quantity returns 201 and creates the cart entry.
preconditions: User is authenticated. Acquire Bearer token via login endpoint and store as <TOKEN>. A valid book exists with id <BOOK_ID>.
steps: POST /cart/items with headers {Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>, Content-Type: application/json} and body {"bookId": <BOOK_ID>, "quantity": 1}
Capture response.body.id as <CART_ITEM_ID>

title: Remove non-existent cart item (404)
description: Negative: removing a cart item that does not exist returns 404 as specified in acceptance criteria.
preconditions: User is authenticated. Acquire Bearer token via login endpoint and store as <TOKEN>.
steps: DELETE /cart/items/99999999 with headers {Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>}

title: Submit order from cart (201)
description: Integration: submitting an order from the cart returns 201 and generates a unique order number.
preconditions: User is authenticated. Acquire Bearer token via login endpoint and store as <TOKEN>. Cart must have at least one item.
steps: POST /orders with headers {Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>, Content-Type: application/json} and body {}
Capture response.body.orderNo as <ORDER_NO>

title: Validate missing cart fields returns 400
description: Boundary/Negative: sending empty body to add-to-cart returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.
preconditions: User is authenticated. Acquire Bearer token via login endpoint and store as <TOKEN>.
steps: POST /cart/items with headers {Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>, Content-Type: application/json} and body {}
expected_results: response.body.error.details.bookId is present OR response.body.error.details.quantity is present

title: Account lockout after 5 failed logins (REQ-003)
description: Security: After 5 consecutive failed login attempts, the account is locked for 10 minutes. Attempt 6 returns 401 or 429.
preconditions: A valid user exists in the system with known credentials.
steps: Perform 5 successful failed login attempts with wrong password
Attempt 6th login with correct credentials

title: Correct login returns 200 and token (REQ-003-AC1)
description: Happy path: Valid credentials return 200 and an access token.
preconditions: A valid user exists in the system.
steps: POST /auth/login with headers {Content-Type: application/json} and body {"username": "<USERNAME>", "password": "<CORRECT_PASSWORD>"}
